title: Reverse Letters Then Special Characters in a String
summary: Given a string with lowercase letters and special characters, reverse the letters in their original positions and reverse the special characters in their original positions, then return the modified string.
statement: Given a string with lowercase letters and special characters, reverse the letters in their original positions and reverse the special characters in their original positions, then return the modified string.
constraints: Keep letter positions and nonletter positions as two separate classes.
Reverse the sequence of letters across letter positions and independently reverse the sequence of special characters across nonletter positions.
hints: Extract letters and nonletters into separate reversed sequences.
At a letter position take the next reversed letter; otherwise take the next reversed special.
Each class keeps its positions while reversing its internal order.
editorial: Each class keeps its positions while reversing its internal order.

tests.explanation: Reversed letters and reversed specials reconstruct (fad@cb#e).
Letters become dcba while specials become !#, yielding dc!ba#.
